people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
translations.bsb: Then Abraham answered, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord—though I am but dust and ashes—
translations.kjv: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
